column1: 30951§fiscal§ˈfɪskl§adj. 财政的；国库的；财务的§Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth's research on the fiscal vulnerability of Philip Ⅱ (who ruled not only Spain but other regions including much of Belgium from 1556 to 1598) builds on other studies of European early modern state finance, including Hoffman and Norberg's work on the relationship between state finance and political development.§Mauricio Drelichman 与 Hans-Joachim Voth 对腓力二世（1556 至 1598 年间不仅统治西班牙，还统治包括比利时大部分地区在内的其他地区）**财政**脆弱性的研究，建立在其他关于欧洲近代早期国家财政的研究之上，其中包括 Hoffman 与 Norberg 关于国家财政与政治发展之关系的著作。§§§§fiscal vulnerability 财政脆弱性；fiscal policy 财政政策§fiscal policy 财政政策（税收与支出）≠ monetary policy 货币政策§改译文：原译只译了主语就以「……」收尾，按英文补全

30952§scope§skəʊp§n. 范围；领域；（发挥的）余地；机会§Encompassing both early (e.g., Fritz Leiber's 1950 story "Coming Attraction") and more recent (e.g., Erica Satifka's 2021 story "Act of Providence") contributions, the broad chronological scope of Shurin's volume may make it seem more comprehensive than Mirrorshades, but Mirrorshades's focus is more carefully considered, rendering it the more authoritative anthology of this science fiction subgenre.§由于既收录早期作品（如弗里茨·莱伯 1950 年的《即将到来的吸引力》），也收录较新的作品（如埃丽卡·萨蒂夫卡 2021 年的《天意之举》），Shurin 这部选集宽广的年代**跨度**也许会让它显得比《Mirrorshades》更全面；但《Mirrorshades》的选材重点经过更周密的考量，使它成为这一科幻子类型更具权威性的选集。§The anthology has a vast chronological scope, including both James Tiptree Jr.’s “The Girl Who Was Plugged In” (1973) and Lavanya Lakshminarayanan’s “Etudes” (2020).§这部选集年代**跨度**极大，既收录了 James Tiptree Jr. 的《插电女孩》（1973），也收录了 Lavanya Lakshminarayanan 的《练习曲》（2020）。§§the broad scope 宽泛的范围；scope for improvement 改进空间§§改译文：原译只译了开头的分词短语（收录早晚期作品），漏了主句

30953§earnings§ˈɜːnɪŋz§n. 收入；收益；利润；（影片）票房§A student claims that opening weekend earnings can reliably predict whether a film will be nominated for an Oscar: films that draw large audiences at the beginning of their release are the most likely contenders to earn these coveted award nominations.§一名学生声称，一部电影的首周末**票房**能够可靠地预测它是否会获得奥斯卡提名：上映之初吸引大批观众的电影，最有可能获得这些令人垂涎的奖项提名。§The team found that the greater the exposure to sunshine at work in the two weeks before a manager submitted an earnings forecast, the more the manager’s forecast exceeded what the company actually earned that year.§团队发现：管理者提交**盈利**预测前两周在工作中晒的太阳越多，其预测超出公司当年实际盈利的幅度就越大。§§opening weekend earnings 首周末票房；an earnings forecast 盈利预测§常用复数；与 revenue（营收）不同，earnings 更接近利润§改译文：漏译冒号后的解释（上映之初吸引大批观众的电影最可能获提名）

30954§corps§kɔː(r)§n. （军队的）兵团；特种部队；（从事同一工作的）一群人§The goal was to test the idea of forming a military bicycle corps.§其目标是检验组建一支军事自行车**部队**的构想。§§§§a military bicycle corps 军事自行车部队§与 corpse（尸体）拼写相近，注意区分；复数仍拼 corps，但读 /kɔːz/§原书错：辨析说复数 corps「读音不变」，实则复数读 /kɔːz/，单数读 /kɔː/

30955§vessel§ˈvesl§n. 船；舰；容器；器皿；血管§A merchant vessel is any ship hired to carry cargo or passengers.§商船是指任何受雇运送货物或乘客的**船舶**。§Such decorations came to be a defining feature of German stoneware vessels of the period.§这类装饰后来成为该时期德国炻器**器皿**的标志性特征。§§a merchant vessel 商船；blood vessel 血管§§改例句2：Germ an 应为 German

30956§utility§juːˈtɪləti§n. 效用；实用；有用；公用事业（水、电、燃气等）§Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that this difference in life trajectory should be reflected in the diets of immature orangutans: males should share fewer of their mothers’ dietary preferences than females do since those preferences tend to be particular to the food resources available in the local area and may be of relatively low utility beyond it.§Beatrice Ehmann 及其同事假设，这种生命轨迹上的差异应当反映在未成年红毛猩猩的饮食中：雄性与母亲共有的饮食偏好应当少于雌性，因为这些偏好往往专属于当地可得的食物资源，到了当地以外可能**用处**相对不大。§Extensive travels abroad later sparked an engagement with modernist and functionalist aesthetics—styles whose emphasis on utility and whose repudiation of traditional architecture's more ornamental elements are readily apparent in Barragán's house in Calle Guadiana.§广泛的海外游历随后引燃了他对现代主义与功能主义美学的倾心——这两种风格对**实用**的强调、对传统建筑繁复装饰元素的摒弃，在巴拉干的瓜迪亚纳街住宅中清晰可见。§§the regional electric utility 地区电力公司；practical utility 实用价值§§改译文：原译是另一句（地区电力公司抽水蓄能）的翻译，按英文重译

30957§knight§naɪt§n. （中世纪的）骑士；爵士 v. 封…为爵士§But while no source before 1155 includes references to the famous Round Table at which Arthur’s knights assembled, both the Roman de Brut and Sir Thomas Malory’s 15th-century compilation of Arthurian legends, Le Morte d’Arthur, do.§尽管 1155 年之前没有任何文献提及亚瑟的**骑士**们聚集的那张著名圆桌，但《布鲁特传奇》与托马斯·马洛礼 15 世纪汇编的亚瑟王传说《亚瑟王之死》都提到了它。§While neither History nor any works that predate it mention Arthur's famous Round Table at which his knights assembled, Le Morte d'Arthur does, suggesting that …§尽管《不列颠诸王史》及更早的作品均未提及亚瑟著名的圆桌，**骑士**们环坐其旁，《亚瑟王之死》却写了它，这提示……§§Arthur's knights 亚瑟王的骑士§与 night（夜晚）同音§改译文：原译以「都……」收尾，漏译《亚瑟王之死》和谓语（都提到了圆桌）；改例句2：句末是填空题的空位（一串零宽字符加句点），改为「…」

30958§carrier§ˈkæriə(r)§n. 运输工具（船、飞机等）；运输公司；搬运者；携带者；载体§Common merchant vessels include bulk carriers, cruise liners, and oil tankers.§常见的商船包括**散货船**、邮轮和油轮。§“John of God, the Water-Carrier” is a 1913 short story by María Cristina Mena.§《神之约翰，**担水人**》是玛丽亚·克里斯蒂娜·梅纳 1913 年的短篇小说。§§bulk carriers 散货船；a disease carrier 带菌者§§改译文2：篇名 John of God, the Water-Carrier 误译成「担水人约翰的神」

30959§franchise§ˈfræntʃaɪz§n. 系列作品（品牌）；特许经营权；选举权§But the flow seems to have increased significantly since the early 2010s, with franchise films like Minions and Jurassic World Dominion flooding movie screens.§但自 2010 年代初以来，这股潮流似乎显著增强，《小黄人大眼萌》《侏罗纪世界：统治》等**系列**电影大量涌上银幕。§Critics generally agree that Spider-Man: Far From Home isn't the most exciting franchise movie, but franchise movies are rarely as stale as some people claim.§评论界普遍认同《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》并非最激动人心的**系列**电影，但系列电影也很少像某些人声称的那样陈腐。§§franchise films 系列电影；the franchise 选举权§§

30960§eligible§ˈelɪdʒəbl§adj. 有资格的；符合条件的；合格的§All fifty state constitutions contain clauses that confer the right to vote on eligible citizens.§五十个州的宪法都含有条款，赋予**合格**公民投票权。§§§§eligible citizens 合格公民（选民）；be eligible for sth 有资格获得；ineligible adj. 无资格的§§改例句：句末多一个句点

30961§sole§səʊl§adj. 唯一的；仅有的；独占的§By assessing indicators in multiple domains—such as social relationships and professional and community activity—rather than relying solely on GDP, the United Kingdom gains a truer understanding of its national well-being.§通过评估多个领域的指标——如社会关系、职业与社区活动——而不是**仅仅**依赖 GDP，英国得以更真实地了解本国的国民福祉。§These plants were well suited to the hot, dry climate of Pangaea, the sole landmass on Earth at the time.§这些植物非常适应当时地球上**唯一**的陆块——盘古大陆——炎热干燥的气候。§§solely adv. 仅仅；唯一地§与 soul（灵魂）同音§改译文：原译以「英国得以……」收尾，补全

30962§petition§pəˈtɪʃn§n. 请愿书；请愿；申请书 v. 请愿；正式请求§Louis Pipestone is collecting signatures for a petition from fellow members of the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa on the tribe's reservation in North Dakota. Louis Pipestone tended the petition like a garden.§路易斯·派普斯通正在北达科他州奇珀瓦龟山保留地，为一份**请愿书**向同部落成员征集签名。路易斯·派普斯通像照料花园一样照料着这份请愿书。§Geologist and scholar John Bostock joined with 55 other prominent British writers in 1837 to petition the US Congress for greater copyright protections.§地质学家兼学者 John Bostock 于 1837 年联同另外 55 位英国知名作家，向美国国会**请愿**加强版权保护。§§collect signatures for a petition 为请愿书征集签名；petition the court 向法院申请§§改译文：漏译第二句（像照料花园一样照料请愿书）

30963§intellectual§ˌɪntəˈlektʃuəl§adj. 智力的；理智的；智识的 n. 知识分子§Perhaps it is a little depressing to inherit not lands but an example of intellectual virtue; perhaps the conclusiveness of a great ancestor is a little discouraging to those who run the risk of comparison with him.§也许，继承的不是田产而是一份**智识**美德的典范，多少令人沮丧；也许一位伟大祖先那种无可辩驳的定论，会让后人有些气馁。§A salon is a social gathering for the exploration of intellectual ideas.§沙龙是探讨思想**智识**的社交聚会。§§intellectual virtue 智识美德；a public intellectual 公共知识分子§§改例句2：删去句末混入的无关句「It was evening when the two men got up to leave.」；改译文2：相应删去这句的译文

30964§stem§stem§v. 源于；起源于；由…造成 n. 茎；梗；词干§The prominent featuring of metal stems from the post–World War II emphasis on technological progress, while more traditional natural materials help preserve longstanding architectural and aesthetic approaches.§金属之所以被突出使用，**源于**二战后对技术进步的强调；而更传统的天然材料则有助于维系长久以来的建筑与审美传统。§Established knowledge of prehistoric societies primarily stems from analysis of durable historical artifacts, including gold jewelry pieces, but Ingrid Bertin and team have contributed new insights with a unique analysis of plant-based items.§关于史前社会的既有认识主要**来自**对耐久历史器物（含黄金饰品）的分析；而 Ingrid Bertin 团队凭借对植物制品的独特分析贡献了新洞见。§§stem from 源于；由…造成；word stem 词干§§改译文：原译以「……」收尾，补全

30965§summit§ˈsʌmɪt§n. 山顶；顶峰；峰会 v. 登顶§Mountain summits are often described in terms of their elevation, or height above sea level.§**山峰**常以其海拔——即高出海平面的高度——来描述。§For example, people will always remember that Alessandra Boarelli was a mountaineer and the first woman to summit Monviso in the Italian Alps.§例如，人们将永远记得亚历山德拉·博阿雷利是一位登山家，是**登顶**意大利阿尔卑斯蒙维索峰的第一位女性。§§mountain summits 山峰；a climate summit 气候峰会§§改译文2：Boarelli 误译成「博阿尔迪」

30966§agenda§əˈdʒendə§n. 议程；待议事项；（隐藏的）意图§… she seeks to cultivate a practice of “constant evolution” untethered from any prescriptive agenda …§……她力图培养一种不受任何规定性**议程**束缚的「持续演化」的实践……§§§§a prescriptive agenda 规定性的议程；a hidden agenda 隐藏的动机§§改译文：删去英文里没有的「此外」和后半（让艺术游走于传统与……之间的临界地带）

30967§grave§ɡreɪv§adj. 严重的；严峻的；庄重的 n. 坟墓§His sermon is a sound of words spoken to the ear, and prepared only for present meditation, and extends no farther than the strength of memory can convey it; a book printed is a record, remaining in every man's possession, always ready to renew its acquaintance with his memory, and always ready to be produced as an authority or voucher to any reports he makes out of it, and conveys its contents for ages to come, to the eternity of mortal time, when the author is forgotten in his grave.§他的布道只是说给耳朵听的一串言语，只为当下的默想而备，所及不过记忆之力所能承载的范围；而一本印成的书则是一份记录，留在每个人手中，随时可以与他的记忆重温旧识，随时可以被拿出来，作为他据此所作任何转述的权威或凭证；它还把其内容传诸后世，直至凡人时间的尽头，那时作者早已长眠**墓中**、被人遗忘。§§§§a grave threat 严重威胁§注意与 gravel（砾石）区分§改例句：原书例句只有人名 Robert Graves，不含本词，换成 U07 vouch 条含 grave 的同一真题句；改译文：随例句换成该句（U07 已核对过的）译文

30968§cast§kɑːst§v. 投射（光、影）；使（怀疑）产生；选派（演员）；铸造 n. 演员阵容§His recently published memoirs possibly cast light on this enigma, but given that such details were not provided until after the thirty-page mark, they might as well have remained state secrets.§他新出版的回忆录或许能**照亮**（cast light on）这个谜团，但由于这些细节直到第三十页之后才出现，它们还不如继续当国家机密算了。§Though Chloé Zhao's films are fictional, she incorporates real events into them in a documentary-like style and casts nonprofessional actors who reside in the places that she aims to portray.§虽然赵婷的电影是虚构的，但她以近乎纪录片的方式将真实事件融入其中，并**起用**（casts）居住在故事发生地的非职业演员。§§cast light on 揭示；阐明；cast doubt on 使人怀疑（真题中 cast 最常见的短语）；cast and crew 演职员；cast-iron adj. 铸铁的；毫不动摇的；casting n. 选角；投射（真题 17 次，casting director 选角导演）§cast light on ≈ shed light on / illuminate；与 enigma 同句（高亮 this enigma）§原书错：义项把形容词 cast-iron 和分词 casting 标作名词

30969§domain§dəˈmeɪn§n. 领域；范围；（生物分类）域；领地；（网络）域名§Carl Woese’s 1970s study of methanogens (microbes with no nuclei, such as Methanococcus vannielii, that metabolize hydrogen and carbon dioxide in oxygen-poor environments and produce methane as a by-product) suggested that they did not fit scientists’ then-conventional division of life into two domains, the eukaryotes (having cells with nuclei) and the prokaryotes (missing nuclei).§Carl Woese 在 20 世纪 70 年代对产甲烷菌（一类无细胞核的微生物，如 Methanococcus vannielii，在缺氧环境中代谢氢与二氧化碳并产生甲烷副产物）的研究表明：它们并不符合当时科学界把生命分为两个**域**的常规分法——真核生物（细胞有核）与原核生物（无核）。§Molecular clock evidence indicated that what Woese argued was a third domain of life emerged as early as 3.5 billion years ago.§分子钟证据显示：伍斯主张的「生命第三**域**」，早至 35 亿年前便已出现。§§multiple domains 多个领域；public domain 公有领域§§

30970§engagement§ɪnˈɡeɪdʒmənt§n. 参与；投入；订婚；约定§For example, though young adults don’t always view themselves as essential parties in such matters, reminders of their collective role as future inheritors of problems left unsolved can spark their engagement.§例如，尽管年轻人并不总把自己视为这类事务的关键参与方，但提醒他们作为未解决问题的未来继承者所担负的集体角色，可以激发他们的**参与**。§This approach to research can promote community engagement by offering insight into the daily life of a scientist.§这种研究方法通过让人一窥科学家的日常，能够促进社群**参与**。§§civic engagement 公民参与；community engagement 社群参与§§改译文：原译以「……」收尾，漏了谓语 can spark their engagement

30971§faculty§ˈfæklti§n. （高校）全体教员；系；学院；官能；能力§In 1979 Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented college students and faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions.§1979 年，Daniel Kahneman 与 Amos Tversky 向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的大学生与**大学教师**提出涉及财务的假设性问题。§Other faculty resist this narrow scope, calling instead for an interdisciplinary approach that includes African history, economics, and politics.§另一些**教师**抵制这种狭隘的定位，转而呼吁包含非洲历史、经济与政治的跨学科路径。§§college faculty 大学教师；mental faculties 心智能力§§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30972§romance§rəʊˈmæns§n. 恋爱；爱情；浪漫；传奇故事；浪漫色彩§These superheroines were marginalized in action-oriented plots, serving instead as objects of romance or rescue.§这些女超级英雄在动作主导的情节中被边缘化，只是作为**恋爱**或等待被拯救的对象出现。§Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA) consist primarily of pieces for polite society like genteel romances and other readings favored by elites, whereas the HM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like nonsense verse, and the practical, with advice about religion.§同时代的其他个人抄本（如芬德恩选集）主要由迎合上流社会的作品构成——文雅的**传奇故事**与精英偏爱的读物；而 HM 抄本却独特地偏重通俗与实用：既有打油诗之类的娱乐，也有关于宗教的劝诫。§§the romance of travel 旅行的浪漫§§改译文2：中世纪抄本里的 romances 指骑士传奇，原译「爱情故事」不准

30973§boom§buːm§n. 繁荣；激增；隆隆声 v. 迅速发展；发出隆隆声§Due to the Chorotega region's accessibility, various types of forested areas were converted to cattle pasture as rising international meat prices drove a cattle ranching boom in the 1960s and 1970s.§由于乔罗特加地区交通便利，随着国际肉类价格上涨在 20 世纪 60、70 年代带动养牛业**繁荣**，各类林地被改造成牧场。§Those studying the works of Augusto Roa Bastos, for instance, may inadvertently overlook nuances in his work by focusing only on the most obvious ways in which his style corresponds to the Latin American Boom.§例如，研究奥古斯托·罗亚·巴斯托斯的学者若只关注其风格与「拉美文学**爆炸**」最明显的对应，就可能无意间忽略作品中的细微之处。§§a cattle ranching boom 养牛业的繁荣；the Latin American Boom 拉美文学爆炸§§改译文：漏译 in the 1960s and 1970s

30974§conservation§ˌkɒnsəˈveɪʃn§n. （环境、资源的）保护；保存；节约§Tarabieh conducted a study of consumer attitudes toward Jordanian food and beverage companies and found that for consumers who value environmental conservation, their likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product's risk of causing environmental harm increased.§塔拉比耶研究了约旦食品饮料企业的消费者态度，发现对于重视环境**保护**的消费者而言，当他们感知到产品造成环境危害的风险升高时，购买该产品的可能性就会下降。§They must use the best information available to decide which species are most threatened and therefore most in need of conservation efforts.§他们必须依据现有的最佳信息，判断哪些物种受威胁最深、因而最需要**保护**行动。§§environmental conservation 环境保护；conservation efforts 保护行动§conservation 强调「保护以免损耗」；preservation 强调「保持原状」§改译文：原译后半残缺（「他们的喜好……」），按英文补全
